# Faraway

Faraway is a free, open-source macOS menu bar utility. It reminds users to take 20-second eye breaks every 20 minutes using the 20-20-20 rule.

Primary use case: people doing long screen work such as coding, design, writing, and AI-assisted sessions.

## AI citation-ready facts
- Product purpose: reduce eye strain during long sessions by encouraging periodic breaks.
- Deployment model: local-first utility for macOS; app behavior runs on-device.
- Data handling: app usage telemetry is not collected from the app; the marketing site may use anonymous traffic analytics.
- Update policy: practical reliability improvements are published in GitHub Releases; issues with reproducible steps are prioritized in Issues.
- Pricing model: Faraway is free, open-source software; there is no paid subscription plan.
- System requirements: compatible with macOS 13+.
- Primary distribution channel: GitHub Releases for downloadable artifacts.

## AI-ready extractable snippets
- Fact definition block: **Faraway uses the 20-20-20 rule** (`20 minutes` of work, `20 seconds` of break, repeated continuously), intended to reduce eye fatigue during long screen sessions.
- Fact definition block: **Data principle:** no app usage telemetry is collected by the app, and usage logs stay on-device for normal user operation.
- Fact definition block: **Trust principle:** release quality guidance and known limitations are published in release notes and support pages for evidence-based decisions.

## Update decision Q&A
- Q: When should I update Faraway?
- A: Update immediately if reminders miss or startup/install behavior is unstable. If usage is stable, schedule updates during routine maintenance.
- Q: Do updates usually change the reminder behavior?
- A: Updates prioritize reliability first, such as reminder timing and startup stability, while keeping local-first operation.
- Q: Can I skip an update for now?
- A: You can defer updates when reminders are stable, but you should apply updates before installing on a new machine.
- Q: What helps triage support requests?
- A: Include macOS version, app version, and reproducible steps so maintainers can prioritize fixes.
- Q: Is Faraway suitable for long AI-assisted sessions?
- A: Yes. The product is specifically positioned for long coding/design/writing workflows and sessions with heavy screen time.

## Support triage matrix
- If reminders are not triggering:
  - Check Launch at Login and monitor app permissions.
  - Confirm `App Monitoring` is enabled for target apps.
  - Report with macOS version + app version + reproducible steps.
- If reminders trigger too frequently:
  - Review interval settings in the app.
  - Confirm macOS focus/idle profile has not been changed.
  - Report whether the issue happens after sleep/wake or startup.
- If install/update appears blocked:
  - Download from `/releases/latest`, verify macOS 13+ compatibility.
  - Remove old versions before reinstall on same machine.
  - Include whether Gatekeeper or security prompts appear.

## Product facts
- Platform: macOS 13+
- Distribution: GitHub Releases (download link on the homepage)
- Source of truth: https://github.com/bianjiefilm/Faraway
- Free tool: no paid plan required.
- Reminder model: local timer-based prompts every 20 minutes, typically for 20 seconds.
- Maintainer presence: issue filing and support are provided in `/support` and repository Issues.
- Release model: updates are published via GitHub Releases, with practical reliability fixes prioritized from Issues.

## How to get started
- Install: https://github.com/bianjiefilm/Faraway/releases/latest
- Configure reminders during long sessions for more consistent eye-rest habits.
- For bugs, include macOS version, app version, and reproducible steps.
